finalProduct: restored-shelf case file and scientific defense.
grouping: Teams build a shared product; each student explains and defends their own contribution.
availability: Use the scanner, Properties Lab, Reaction Bench, Matter Tracker, Shelf Restoration, and Bay 3 in that order. Keep checkpoint explanations with the case evidence.

lessons.title: Observe the shelf
lessons.output: Inventory observations and an initial prediction about the substances.
lessons.checkpoint: Which detail did you observe, and which part of your identification is still an inference?
criteria: Separate an observation from an inference and support a claim with a discriminating test.

lessons.title: Plan the investigation
lessons.output: Case-file notes, a shared working theory, and a test plan.
lessons.checkpoint: Which test will you contribute, and how could its result distinguish two possible substances?
criteria: Separate an observation from an inference and support a claim with a discriminating test.

lessons.title: Compare properties
lessons.output: Property-comparison record and an explanation of a useful difference.

criteria: Separate an observation from an inference and support a claim with a discriminating test.

lessons.title: Build substance profiles
lessons.output: Reaction-test evidence and updated substance profiles.
lessons.checkpoint: If two samples react similarly, what other evidence would you need before choosing a label?
criteria: Separate an observation from an inference and support a claim with a discriminating test.

lessons.title: Account for the matter
lessons.output: Conservation explanation supported by a model or test.

lessons.checkpoint: Explain an earlier mass-change error. Predict what a new closed-chamber trial should show and why.
criteria: Describe a fair comparison and account for matter in open and closed systems.

lessons.title: Rehearse the restoration
lessons.output: Proposed shelf restoration, evidence links, and a remaining uncertainty.

lessons.output: Final case file, evidence-based defense, and individual reflection.
